faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Everything you need to know before you drive.
faq.q1: What do I need to rent a van?
faq.a1: A valid driver's license, a credit card for the deposit, and you must be at least 21 years old. International licenses are accepted with a valid passport.
faq.a2: Every rental includes comprehensive insurance with zero deductible for standard use. Optional premium coverage is available for an additional fee.
faq.a3: Hourly rentals include 50 km free per hour, daily rentals include 200 km, and weekly rentals come with unlimited mileage. Extra kilometers are charged at a fair rate.
faq.q4: Can I rent a van one way?
faq.a4: Yes! Pick up at one location and drop off at another. One-way rentals are available between any of our 5+ locations with a small convenience fee.
faq.a5: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your scheduled pickup. Late cancellations and no-shows are charged at the full rental amount.
faq.a6: Yes, you can add up to two additional drivers for a small daily fee. They must meet the same licensing requirements and be present at pickup.
